predictions.quote: in the next few months, we expect Congress is going to pass the Clarity Act, which is going to answer a number of open questions about how crypto market structure should be regulated.
predictions.prediction: Congress will pass the Clarity Act within the next few months, establishing a regulatory framework for crypto market structure.

predictions.quote: we expect that the nature of media itself is going to change because a lot of media is now going to be derived from the prediction markets.

predictions.quote: I think in the pretty near future, our favorite besties are going to be trading directly in their group chat.
predictions.prediction: In the near future, people will trade stocks, crypto, and other assets directly within group chats via bots.
